title: Surreal Gallery Muse
description: A large surreal painting dominates a dimly lit art gallery, featuring a stylized woman's face with orange and blue flowing hair, dramatic black lips and a crescent moon on her forehead. A silhouetted man stands observing the artwork while other classical paintings hang on the dark teal walls.
prompt: A surreal painting hanging in a dimly lit art gallery, featuring a stylized female face with large expressive eyes, black lips, and a crescent moon on her forehead. Her hair flows dramatically in vibrant orange, teal, and blue waves that blend into abstract patterns with skulls and sea creatures. A silhouetted viewer stands observing the massive artwork while classical paintings in ornate gold frames hang on the dark walls nearby.
